name: English
note: Ghana's official language and widely used in government, education, business and tourism.

name: Akan
note: A major language group including Twi varieties such as Asante Twi and Akuapem Twi, as well as Fante.

name: Ewe
note: Widely spoken in the Volta area and neighbouring communities.

name: Ga
note: Spoken especially in parts of Greater Accra.

name: Dangme
note: Spoken in parts of Greater Accra and the Dangme-speaking areas.

name: Dagbani
note: A major language of the Dagbon area in northern Ghana.

name: Dagaare
note: Spoken in parts of the Upper West area.

name: Gonja
note: Spoken in parts of the Savannah area and surrounding communities.

name: Kasem
note: Spoken in parts of the Upper East area.

name: Gurene (Frafra)
note: Spoken in parts of the Upper East area.

name: Kusaal
note: Spoken in parts of north-eastern Ghana.

name: Buli
note: Spoken by communities in the Builsa area.

name: Mampruli
note: Spoken in parts of the North East and northern Ghana.

name: Nzema
note: Spoken in parts of the Western coastal area.

name: Sefwi
note: Spoken in parts of Western North.

name: Wasa
note: Spoken in parts of the Western area.

name: Akyem
note: Akan variety spoken in parts of the Eastern area.

name: Akuapem Twi
note: A Twi variety associated with Akuapem communities.

name: Asante Twi
note: A widely spoken Twi variety, especially in Ashanti and across Ghana.

name: Fante
note: An Akan variety spoken especially in Central and coastal communities.

name: Nkonya
note: A language spoken in some communities in the Oti/Volta area.

name: Konkomba
note: Spoken in communities in northern and north-eastern Ghana.

name: Chakali
note: A language spoken in parts of the Upper West area.

name: Gikyode
note: A language spoken in parts of the Oti area.

name: Tampulma
note: A language spoken in parts of northern Ghana.

name: Kplang
note: A language spoken in parts of the Oti area.
